t: The $(item)Machine Infuser$() uses $(l:rftoolsbase:basics/dimensional_shards)Dimensional Shards$() to $(thing)improve the efficiency$() of a lot of machines. For most things, infusing them will reduce their power requirements. Some devices will have additional benefits from infusion. $(br2)$(thing)Infusing$() the Infuser will cause it to use less power.
$(item)机器注能机$()使用$(l:rftoolsbase:basics/dimensional_shards)次元裂片$()来$(thing)提高许多机器的效率$()。对大多数设备来说，注能会降低其能量消耗。有些设备还会从注能中获得额外收益。$(br2)$(thing)为注能机本身进行注能$()会使其消耗更少能量。
See overleaf for additional uses for the Machine Infuser, depending on what other mods you have installed.
请参见背页，了解机器注能机的更多用途，这些用途取决于你安装了哪些其他模组。
